podcast.title: 1985 Concert Advertisement Mention
podcast.body: Honeymoon Suite was mentioned in a 1985 concert commercial, appearing in conjunction with "38 specials." The ad copy included phrases like "Back where you been stuck against the high moon suite." "Honeymoon suite."

xref.title: 1985 Concert Advertisement
xref.body: A radio commercial from 1985 featured "38 specials" presenting a concert, described as "the strength of rock and roll back and back alive." This advertisement appeared alongside promotion for Honeymoon Suite. "The strength of rock and roll back and back alive in some concerts, present 38 specials."
